hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A binary sequence avoiding both target subpatterns is restricted to small canonical configurations.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Candidate valid forms are all zeros, all ones, at most one one, or ones only at both endpoints.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Evaluate the flip cost for each candidate configuration and select the minimum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minFlipsToMakeCoherent(s: str) -> int:
    n = len(s)
    total_ones = s.count('1')
    total_zeros = n - total_ones
    ans = total_ones
    ans = min(ans, total_zeros)
    if total_ones > 0:
        ans = min(ans, total_ones - 1)
    if n >= 2:
        cost = (0 if s[0] == '1' else 1) + (0 if s[-1] == '1' else 1)
        cost += s[1:-1].count('1')
        ans = min(ans, cost)
    return ans
```

complexity.notes: Evaluates constant number of structural candidate shapes in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n binary strings is intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct count inspection uses constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that forbidden subsequences reduce valid strings to simple canonical forms.
